name: Minecraft: SpongeForge
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Sponge plugins together with Forge or NeoForge mods on Minecraft Java. Installs the loader version Sponge is built for and Sponge itself, checked against their checksums.
startup: read -r need most 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v most="$most" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } if (most != "" && have + 0 > most + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version runs on Java %s at most, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", most, have, most; exit 1 } exit }' && if [ -f unix_args.txt ]; then exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true @user_jvm_args.txt @unix_args.txt nogui; else exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: SpongeForge. Picks the Sponge build for the chosen Minecraft
# version, runs the Forge or NeoForge installer it needs (checked against
# their checksums), and puts Sponge in mods/. Worlds, mods, plugins,
# configs and your Java options are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Installers work in a folder of the server's own (the install container's
# /tmp is small), removed however the script ends.
trap 'rm -rf .raptor-installer' EXIT

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# True when version $1 is $2 or older.
older_or_same() { [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = "$1" ]; }
# Downloads $1 to $2 and checks it against $3, its published checksum
# (sha256:…, sha1:… or md5:…); a jar with none must at least be a whole
# zip. Only then is it put in place.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$2.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.new"; fail "The download from $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ]; then
        if [ "$("${3%%:*}sum" "$2.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${3#*:}" ]; then
            rm -f "$2.new"
            fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        fi
    elif [[ $2 == *.jar ]] && ! unzip -tq "$2.new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$2.new"
        fail "The download isn't a whole jar file. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.new" "$2"
}
# True when file $1 has the checksum $2 (as fetch takes it).
matches() { [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$("${2%%:*}sum" "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${2#*:}" ]; }
# The Java version Minecraft $1 needs, from Mojang's version list (8 for
# versions older than the list says).
java_for() {
    local url
    url=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$1" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url') || true
    if [ -n "$url" ]; then get "$url" | jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' || echo 8; else echo 8; fi
}
# Writes the Java versions the server runs on to .raptor-java, which the
# startup command checks: the oldest, and for $2 the newest, if any.
write_java() {
    echo "$1${2:+ $2}" > .raptor-java
}
# The newest Java that Forge, and the servers built on Forge or on its
# launcher, run on for Minecraft $1: 8 before 1.13 (LaunchWrapper), 11
# before 1.17 (the old ModLauncher fails on Java 16's locked-down
# internals). Nothing for newer versions.
java_most() {
    [[ $1 == 1.* ]] || return 0
    if older_or_same "$1" 1.12.2; then echo 8
    elif older_or_same "$1" 1.16.5; then echo 11; fi
}
# How to say which Java it runs on.
java_text() {
    if [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then echo "Java $1 or newer"
    elif [ "$1" = "$2" ]; then echo "Java $1 only"
    else echo "Java $1 to $2"; fi
}

# Runs a Forge or NeoForge installer ($1, its SHA-256 $2, named $3) in a
# folder of its own, and only once it has succeeded moves what it made into
# the server: the libraries, and how to start it. Minecraft 1.17 and newer
# start from the launch arguments it writes (unix_args.txt, and the small
# jar they name in newer versions), with your own Java options in
# user_jvm_args.txt; older versions from the server jar, saved as the jar
# file name.
run_installer() {
    local url=$1 sum=$2 name=$3 stage=.raptor-installer args jar
    rm -rf "$stage"
    mkdir "$stage"
    echo "Downloading the $name installer"
    fetch "$url" "$stage/installer.jar" "sha256:$sum"
    echo "Running the $name installer. This takes a minute or two."
    if ! (cd "$stage" && mkdir tmp && HOME="$PWD/tmp" java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -Djava.io.tmpdir="$PWD/tmp" -jar installer.jar --installServer >installer-output.log 2>&1); then
        tail -n 20 "$stage/installer-output.log"
        rm -rf "$stage"
        fail "The $name installer failed (its last lines are above). Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mkdir -p libraries
    cp -a "$stage/libraries/." libraries/
    args=$(find "$stage/libraries" -name unix_args.txt | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "$args" ]; then
        cp "$args" unix_args.txt.new
        mv -f unix_args.txt.new unix_args.txt
        [ -f user_jvm_args.txt ] || cp "$stage/user_jvm_args.txt" user_jvm_args.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "# Your own Java options, one per line." > user_jvm_args.txt
        # Newer versions start from a small jar the arguments name.
        find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*-shim.jar' -delete
        find "$stage" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jar' ! -name installer.jar -exec mv -f {} . \;
    else
        jar=$(find "$stage" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jar' ! -name installer.jar ! -name 'minecraft_server.*' | sort | head -n 1)
        [ -n "$jar" ] || { rm -rf "$stage"; fail "The $name installer didn't make a server jar. Reinstall to try again."; }
        find "$stage" -maxdepth 1 -name 'minecraft_server.*.jar' -exec cp {} . \;
        mv -f "$jar" "${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
        rm -f unix_args.txt
    fi
    rm -rf "$stage"
}
# True when what starts the server is all there.
launch_ready() {
    local j
    if [ -f unix_args.txt ]; then
        j=$(awk '{ for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "-jar") print $(i + 1) }' unix_args.txt)
        [ -z "$j" ] || [ -f "$j" ]
    else
        [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}" ]
    fi
}

forge_maven=https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge
# Every Forge version, as Minecraft-Forge (1.20.1-47.3.0; the oldest end
# with -<Minecraft> again).
forge_versions() {
    get "$forge_maven/maven-metadata.xml" | grep -o '<version>[^<]*</version>' | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>//g'
}
# The full Forge version for Forge $1 on Minecraft $2 (or any Minecraft for
# latest), from the list $3. Takes 47.3.0, 1.20.1-47.3.0, or the build alone
# for the oldest (2838 for 14.23.5.2838).
forge_full() {
    awk -F- -v f="$1" -v m="$2" '$0 == f || ((m == "latest" || $1 == m) && ($2 == f || $2 ~ ("\\." f "$"))) { print; exit }' <<<"$3"
}
# Installs Forge $1 (a full version) unless it's already there.
install_forge() {
    local full=$1 sum
    if [ "$(cat .raptor-loader 2>/dev/null)" = "forge $full" ] && launch_ready; then
        echo "Forge $full is already installed."
        return
    fi
    sum=$(get "$forge_maven/$full/forge-$full-installer.jar.sha256") ||
        fail "Forge $full has no server installer to run. Choose a newer Forge version."
    run_installer "$forge_maven/$full/forge-$full-installer.jar" "$sum" "Forge $full"
    echo "forge $full" > .raptor-loader
}

neo_maven=https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged
# NeoForge's versions for Minecraft $1: its own for 1.20.2 and newer
# (21.1.x is 1.21.1, 26.1.2.x is 26.1.2), its Forge fork's for 1.20.1.
neo_artifact() { if [ "$1" = 1.20.1 ]; then echo forge; else echo neoforge; fi; }
neo_versions() {
    get "https://maven.neoforged.net/api/maven/versions/releases/net/neoforged/$1" | jq -r '.versions[]'
}
neo_prefix() {
    local v=$1
    case "$v" in
    1.20.1) echo "1.20.1-" ;;
    1.*) v=${v#1.}; [[ $v == *.* ]] || v="$v.0"; echo "$v." ;;
    *) [[ $v == *.*.* ]] || v="$v.0"; echo "$v." ;;
    esac
}
# The Minecraft version NeoForge $1 is for.
neo_minecraft() {
    local a b c
    case "$1" in 1.20.1-* | 47.*) echo 1.20.1; return ;; esac
    IFS=. read -r a b c _ <<<"${1%%-*}"
    if [ "$a" -ge 25 ]; then
        if [ "$c" = 0 ]; then echo "$a.$b"; else echo "$a.$b.$c"; fi
    elif [ "$b" = 0 ]; then echo "1.$a"; else echo "1.$a.$b"; fi
}
# Installs NeoForge $1 unless it's already there.
install_neoforge() {
    local v=$1 artifact sum
    artifact=$(neo_artifact "$(neo_minecraft "$v")")
    if [ "$(cat .raptor-loader 2>/dev/null)" = "neoforge $v" ] && launch_ready; then
        echo "NeoForge $v is already installed."
        return
    fi
    sum=$(get "$neo_maven/$artifact/$v/$artifact-$v-installer.jar.sha256") ||
        fail "NeoForge $v has no server installer to run. Choose another NeoForge version."
    run_installer "$neo_maven/$artifact/$v/$artifact-$v-installer.jar" "$sum" "NeoForge $v"
    echo "neoforge $v" > .raptor-loader
}

sponge_api=https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts
# Picks the Sponge build of artifact $1 (spongevanilla, spongeforge or
# spongeneo) for Minecraft $2 (or latest) and the version choice $3
# (recommended, latest, or a full version such as 1.21.4-14.0.0), setting
# sponge_version, sponge_json (its details) and mc.
sponge_pick() {
    local artifact=$1 want=$2 choice=$3 tags newest
    tags=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact" | jq -r '.tags.minecraft[]') ||
        fail "Sponge's version list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    newest=$(grep -E '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+$' <<<"$tags" | head -n 1)
    case "$choice" in
    recommended | latest | "")
        mc=$want
        [ "$mc" = latest ] && mc=$newest
        grep -qxF -- "$mc" <<<"$tags" ||
            fail "Sponge has no Minecraft $mc. Set Minecraft version to latest, or to a version Sponge has, such as $newest."
        sponge_version=""
        if [ "$choice" != latest ]; then
            sponge_version=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions?tags=minecraft:$mc&recommended=true&limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys_unsorted[0] // empty') || true
        fi
        if [ -z "$sponge_version" ]; then
            sponge_version=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions?tags=minecraft:$mc&limit=1" | jq -r '.artifacts | keys_unsorted[0] // empty') || true
            [ -n "$sponge_version" ] || fail "Sponge has no build for Minecraft $mc to install."
            [ "$choice" = latest ] || echo "Minecraft $mc has no recommended Sponge build, so this is its newest one."
        fi
        ;;
    *) sponge_version=$choice ;;
    esac
    sponge_json=$(get "$sponge_api/$artifact/versions/$sponge_version") ||
        fail "Sponge has no version $sponge_version. Set Sponge version to recommended, latest, or a version Sponge has."
    local got
    got=$(jq -r '.tags.minecraft' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ "$want" = latest ] || [ "$want" = "$got" ] ||
        fail "Sponge $sponge_version is for Minecraft $got, not $want. Set Minecraft version to $got or latest."
    mc=$got
}
# The download link and checksum of the build's server jar.
sponge_jar() {
    sponge_url=$(jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.extension == "jar" and (.classifier == "universal" or .classifier == ""))] | sort_by(.classifier != "universal") | .[0].downloadUrl // empty' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ -n "$sponge_url" ] || fail "Sponge $sponge_version has no server jar to download."
    local sum
    if sum=$(get "$sponge_url.sha256" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        sponge_sum="sha256:${sum%% *}"
    else
        sponge_sum="md5:$(jq -r --arg u "$sponge_url" '.assets[] | select(.downloadUrl == $u) | .md5' <<<"$sponge_json")"
    fi
}

type="${SPONGE_TYPE:-spongeforge}"
sponge_pick "$type" "${SF_MC_VERSION:-latest}" "${SPONGE_VERSION:-recommended}"
sponge_jar
if [ "$type" = spongeneo ]; then
    loader=$(jq -r '.tags.neoforge // empty' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ -n "$loader" ] || fail "Sponge $sponge_version doesn't say which NeoForge it needs."
    list=$(neo_versions "$(neo_artifact "$mc")") || fail "NeoForge's version list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    neo=$(grep -xE -- "$(sed 's/\./\\./g' <<<"$loader")(-beta)?" <<<"$list" | head -n 1) ||
        fail "NeoForge has no version $loader, which Sponge $sponge_version needs."
    install_neoforge "$neo"
    loader="NeoForge $neo"
else
    loader=$(jq -r '.tags.forge // empty' <<<"$sponge_json")
    [ -n "$loader" ] || fail "Sponge $sponge_version doesn't say which Forge it needs."
    all=$(forge_versions) || fail "Forge's version list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    full=$(forge_full "$loader" "$mc" "$all")
    [ -n "$full" ] || fail "Forge has no version $loader for Minecraft $mc, which Sponge $sponge_version needs."
    if [[ $loader != *.* ]]; then
        # Legacy Sponge names the oldest Forge build it works with, whose
        # libraries clash with it; Forge's recommended build is the one to run.
        rec=$(get https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/promotions_slim.json | jq -r --arg k "$mc-recommended" '.promos[$k] // empty') || true
        if [ -n "$rec" ] && [ "${rec##*.}" -ge "$loader" ] 2>/dev/null; then
            full=$(forge_full "$rec" "$mc" "$all")
        fi
    fi
    install_forge "$full"
    loader="Forge $full"
fi

# Sponge itself is a mod: replace an older Sponge in mods/ with this one.
name="$type-$sponge_version.jar"
mkdir -p mods
if matches "mods/$name" "$sponge_sum"; then
    echo "Sponge $sponge_version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Sponge $sponge_version"
    fetch "$sponge_url" "mods/$name" "$sponge_sum"
fi
find mods -maxdepth 1 -name "$type-*.jar" ! -name "$name" -delete
need=$(java_for "$mc")
most=$(java_most "$mc")
write_java "$need" "$most"
echo "Installed Sponge $sponge_version on $loader for Minecraft $mc. It runs on $(java_text "$need" "$most")."

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.1, or latest for the newest one Sponge supports. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Loader
variables.description: Which mod loader runs Sponge: spongeforge for Forge, or spongeneo for NeoForge.

variables.name: Sponge version
variables.description: Which Sponge build: recommended, latest, or a full version such as 1.21.1-52.1.5-12.0.4.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.
